keywords.name: stress-principal
keywords.description: Principal stress states, specified by value and by direction using the available keywords. Note that at least two directions must be specified, and magnitudes not specified are assumed to be zero. Note that the [zoneinitializeblock] is available after each of the following keywords, allowing them to be varied in space independently. This command should be used after assigning a constitutive model. Options: direction-intermediate <v>: Direction of intermediate principal stress.; direction-maximum <v>: Direction of maximum principal stress.; direction-minimum <v>: Direction of minimum principal stress.; intermediate <f>: Intermediate principal stress magnitude.; maximum <f>: Maximum (most postitive) principal stress.; minimum <f>: Minimum (most negative) principal stress.

keywords.description: Full stress state, specified by component. A component that is not specified is assumed to be zero. This command should be used after assigning a constitutive model. Options: xx <f>: xx -component of stress.; xy <f>: xy -component of stress.; xz <f>3D Only: xz -component of stress.; yy <f>: yy -component of stress.; yz <f>3D Only: yz -component of stress.; zz <f>: zz -component of stress. initialize the full stress tensor (six components) for zones in the range. Requires a non-null constitutive model assigned beforehand.

keywords.name: stress-principal
keywords.syntax: stress-principal [{direction-intermediate <v> [zoneinitializeblock] | direction-maximum <v> [zoneinitializeblock] | direction-minimum <v> [zoneinitializeblock] | intermediate <f> [zoneinitializeblock] | maximum <f> [zoneinitializeblock] | minimum <f> [zoneinitializeblock] | dip-maximum <f> 3D Only | dip-direction-maximum <f> 3D Only | dip-intermediate <f> 3D Only | dip-direction-intermediate <f> 3D Only | dip-minimum <f> 3D Only | dip-direction-minimum <f> 3D Only} ...]
keywords.description: Principal stress states, specified by value and by direction using the available keywords. Note that at least two directions must be specified, and magnitudes not specified are assumed to be zero. Note that the [zoneinitializeblock] is available after each of the following keywords, allowing them to be varied in space independently. This command should be used after assigning a constitutive model. Options: direction-intermediate <v>[zoneinitializeblock]: Direction of intermediate principal stress.; direction-maximum <v>[zoneinitializeblock]: Direction of maximum principal stress.; direction-minimum <v>[zoneinitializeblock]: Direction of minimum principal stress.; intermediate <f>[zoneinitializeblock]: Intermediate principal stress magnitude.; maximum <f>[zoneinitializeblock]: Maximum (most postitive) principal stress.; minimum <f>[zoneinitializeblock]: Minimum (most negative) principal stress.; dip-maximum <f>3D Only: Set dip of maximum principal stress. Dip and dip-direction can be given instead of the vector orientation. Orientations only need to be specified for two principal components.; dip-direction-maximum <f>3D Only: Set dip direction of maximum principal stress. Dip and dip-direction can be given instead of the vector orientation. Orientations only need to be specified for two principal components.; dip-intermediate <f>3D Only: Set dip of intermediate principal stress. Dip and dip-direction can be given instead of the vector orientation. Orientations only need to be specified for two principal components.; dip-direction-intermediate <f>3D Only: Set dip direction of intermediate principal stress. Dip and dip-direction can be given instead of the vector orientation. Orientations only need to be specified for two principal components.; dip-minimum <f>3D Only: Set dip of minimum principal stress. Dip and dip-direction can be given instead of the vector orientation. Orientations only need to be specified for two principal components.; dip-direction-minimum <f>3D Only: Set dip direction of minimum principal stress. Dip and dip-direction can be given instead of the vector orientation. Orientations only need to be specified for two principal directions. initialize zone principal stresses, specified by magnitudes (maximum/intermediate/minimum) and by direction (direction-maximum/direction-intermediate/direction-minimum). At least two principal directions must be specified. Requires a non-null constitutive model assigned beforehand.

notes: '[zoneinitializeblock]' at the end of a keyword's syntax is not a literal token: it marks where this command's shared modifier keywords may follow (stress, add, gradient, multiply, vary).
